question: How do I find a lawyer on the platform?
answer: Once you create an account as a client, you can browse lawyer profiles, check their expertise, and book an appointment with a suitable lawyer.

question: How do I book an appointment with a lawyer?
answer: After selecting a lawyer, click the "Book Appointment" button on their profile, choose a time slot, and confirm your booking

question: Can I chat with my lawyer through the platform?
answer: Yes! Once your case is assigned, you can use the built-in messaging system to communicate with your lawyer.

question: How do I make payments for legal services?
answer: Your lawyer will send payment requests through the platform. You can view pending invoices on your Payment page and complete transactions securely.

question: Where can I see my ongoing cases?
answer: All your assigned cases will be listed on the "My Cases" page, where you can track progress, upcoming hearings, and deadlines.
